detailed_descriptions.en: Dead by Daylight’s All Things Wicked delves into the depths of analog horror with new Killer, The Unknown , and new Survivor, Sable Ward . A new Map, Greenville Square , is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Unknown’s Garden Casual and Sable Ward’s Designer Corset . THE UNKNOWN If you hear a soft voice crying out for help in the woods, stay the hell away. The true nature of The Unknown remains a mystery, barring one fatal certainty: to cross its path is to risk an unknowable fate. The Unknown’s Power: UVX (Unknown Venom X) Charge and launch a burst of UVX, which bounces once and creates a Blast Area upon impact. If they touch the Blast Area, they will become Weakened against your Power. If a Survivor is Weakened, they will lose a Health State whenever they touch a Blast Area. Survivors can lose the Weakened status by successfully looking at The Unknown for a brief duration. Special Ability: Hallucinations During a Trial, The Unknown will intermittently create Hallucinations and leave them in its wake. The Unknown can highlight and teleport to any Hallucination, leaving behind a temporary Decoy version of itself. Survivors can Dispel Hallucinations, but only by staring at one while standing completely still. Weakened Survivors will take longer to Dispel a Hallucination, and any incomplete attempt will reveal their location through Killer Instinct. The Unknown comes with 3 new perks. Unbound Unbound activates for a duration when a Survivor becomes injured. During this time, you’ll gain a brief speed boost whenever you Vault a Window. Unforeseen When you kick a Generator, your Terror Radius transfers to it for a duration. During this time, your Terror Radius increases and you become Undetectable. Undone Gain Tokens whenever a Survivor misses a Skill Check. When you damage a Generator, all Tokens will be consumed. For each Token consumed, the Generator loses 1% total progress and becomes blocked for 1 second. SABLE WARD While some fear the darkness, Sable Ward embraces it. Fascinated by horror and drawn to all things wicked, Sable was among the few Survivors to willingly step into The Fog in search of her best friend Mikaela. Sable Ward comes with 3 new perks. Invocation: Weaving Spiders This Invocation can only be performed in the Basement and takes a considerable duration of time to complete. Survivors can see your Aura during the process and can join you, increasing the Invocation’s speed. Once complete, all Survivors will gain a boost of Repair progress. On the other hand, you’ll be Injured and Broken for the remainder of the Trial. Strength in Shadows When in the basement, you can quickly heal without a Med-Kit. Afterward, the Killer’s Aura is briefly revealed. Wicked Gain the ability to successfully unhook yourself from Basement Hooks. When you successfully do so, the Killer’s Aura is briefly revealed. NEW MAP: GREENVILLE SQUARE* A slice of small-town Americana, long abandoned, long forgotten. Now, something wanders freely along the overgrown streets: a writhing creature responsible for a string of disappearances across the country. *This map is free for all players. EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER KILLER ITEM: GARDEN CASUAL Her prize-winning peonies wilted and died without someone to care for them. The All Things Wicked Chapter includes an exclusive item for The Unknown, the Garden Casual Outfit , only available as part of the DLC. Please note that this item cannot be purchased separately. EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER SURVIVOR ITEM: DESIGNER CORSET Once she saw it in the store window, she knew she had a reason to save her money. The All Things Wicked Chapter includes an exclusive item for Sable, the Designer Corset , only available as part of the DLC. Please note that this item cannot be purchased separately. If you’re seeing this, your fate has been sealed.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Dead by Daylight’s All Things Wicked delves into the depths of analog horror with new Killer, The Unknown, and new Survivor, Sable Ward. A new Map, Greenville Square, is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Unknown’s Garden Casual and Sable Ward’s Designer Corset.

THE UNKNOWN

If you hear a soft voice crying out for help in the woods, stay the hell away. The true nature of The Unknown remains a mystery, barring one fatal certainty: to cross its path is to risk an unknowable fate.

The Unknown’s Power: UVX (Unknown Venom X)

Charge and launch a burst of UVX, which bounces once and creates a Blast Area upon impact. If they touch the Blast Area, they will become Weakened against your Power.
If a Survivor is Weakened, they will lose a Health State whenever they touch a Blast Area. Survivors can lose the Weakened status by successfully looking at The Unknown for a brief duration.

Special Ability: Hallucinations

During a Trial, The Unknown will intermittently create Hallucinations and leave them in its wake. The Unknown can highlight and teleport to any Hallucination, leaving behind a temporary Decoy version of itself. Survivors can Dispel Hallucinations, but only by staring at one while standing completely still. Weakened Survivors will take longer to Dispel a Hallucination, and any incomplete attempt will reveal their location through Killer Instinct.



The Unknown comes with 3 new perks.

Unbound

Unbound activates for a duration when a Survivor becomes injured. During this time, you’ll gain a brief speed boost whenever you Vault a Window.

Unforeseen

When you kick a Generator, your Terror Radius transfers to it for a duration. During this time, your Terror Radius increases and you become Undetectable.

Undone

Gain Tokens whenever a Survivor misses a Skill Check. When you damage a Generator, all Tokens will be consumed. For each Token consumed, the Generator loses 1% total progress and becomes blocked for 1 second.

SABLE WARD

While some fear the darkness, Sable Ward embraces it. Fascinated by horror and drawn to all things wicked, Sable was among the few Survivors to willingly step into The Fog in search of her best friend Mikaela.
Sable Ward comes with 3 new perks.

Invocation: Weaving Spiders

This Invocation can only be performed in the Basement and takes a considerable duration of time to complete. Survivors can see your Aura during the process and can join you, increasing the Invocation’s speed.
Once complete, all Survivors will gain a boost of Repair progress. On the other hand, you’ll be Injured and Broken for the remainder of the Trial.

Strength in Shadows

When in the basement, you can quickly heal without a Med-Kit. Afterward, the Killer’s Aura is briefly revealed.

Wicked

Gain the ability to successfully unhook yourself from Basement Hooks. When you successfully do so, the Killer’s Aura is briefly revealed.

NEW MAP: GREENVILLE SQUARE*


A slice of small-town Americana, long abandoned, long forgotten. Now, something wanders freely along the overgrown streets: a writhing creature responsible for a string of disappearances across the country.
*This map is free for all players.


EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER KILLER ITEM: GARDEN CASUAL

Her prize-winning peonies wilted and died without someone to care for them. The All Things Wicked Chapter includes an exclusive item for The Unknown, the Garden Casual Outfit, only available as part of the DLC. Please note that this item cannot be purchased separately.

EXCLUSIVE CHAPTER SURVIVOR ITEM: DESIGNER CORSET

Once she saw it in the store window, she knew she had a reason to save her money. The All Things Wicked Chapter includes an exclusive item for Sable, the Designer Corset, only available as part of the DLC. Please note that this item cannot be purchased separately.


If you’re seeing this, your fate has been sealed.
